# Alphabets

The default alphabet and length, and checking a custom alphabet.

<h2 id="nano-id-alphabet"><code>NanoIdAlphabet</code></h2>

```rux
pub const NanoIdAlphabet = "useandom-26T198340PX75pxJACKVERYMINDBUSHWOLF_GQZbfghjklqvwyzrict";
```

Nano ID's default alphabet: the sixty-four URL-safe characters `A`–`Z`, `a`–`z`, `0`–`9`, `_` and `-`.
Listed in the reference implementation's order, so the same random bytes give the same identifier here as there.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/NanoId/Src/Alphabet.rux#L16)

<h2 id="nano-id-length"><code>NanoIdLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub const NanoIdLength: uint = 21;
```

The default identifier length, in characters: twenty-one.
Twenty-one characters of the default alphabet carry 126 random bits, more than the 122 of a version 4 UUID, in
twenty-one characters where the UUID takes thirty-six.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/NanoId/Src/Alphabet.rux#L22)

<h2 id="validate-alphabet"><code>ValidateAlphabet</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ValidateAlphabet(alphabet: char8[..]) -> ! NanoIdError
```

Checks that `alphabet` can be drawn from without bias.
It must hold between two and 256 characters, all ASCII and all distinct. Reports `AlphabetTooSmall`,
`AlphabetTooLarge`, `NonAsciiCharacter` or `DuplicateCharacter`, the last two with the offset of the offending
byte. Runs in time linear in the alphabet's length and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/NanoId/Src/Alphabet.rux#L50)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type        | Description                                      |
| ---------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `alphabet` | `char8[..]` | the characters an identifier would be drawn from |

**Returns**: success when the alphabet is usable
